title: KP14 with a CRASH-ONLY cash-flow factor: one type, cash flows x e^{0.07 y}, y's Gaussian shocks unpriced, a priced crash of y to -3.5 sd at 1%/month (weight e^2)
question: Group 1, harmonized: does a priced crash in a factor every firm is exposed to create room or a gap on its own, with no interaction?
notes: Campaign 2026-10-14. Built on the single-type 3a economy vy1 with gamma_v 2.5 -> 0, so the crash is the only priced part of y. Pairs with bvy1j (BGN) and gvy1j (GS21).
